name: Rape Ma no Otoko
source:
A mysterious man about 30 years old. He is the one that always rapes Yuuna.

[spoiler]Is later revealed that he actually is Shizuki from the future. He can also time warp and always rapes Yuuna because he holds a grudge against her.[/spoiler]
